title: bOrPa
tagline: Simple cross-chain swapping tool to trade ARB for OP or vice versa via Connext and Polybase
description: This project was an experiment with using different cross-chain and on and off-chain technologies to create a messaging system that allows users to perform cross chain swaps. Specifically with the recent launch of ARB tokens, users may way to trade across Arbitrum and Optimism to speculate on their respective chain tokens. This can be accomplished with a simple messaging protocol using Connext.
how_its_made: This project uses @Connext and @Polybase and is deployed on a number of Testnet chains. It uses the basics like @Vite and @Hardhat as frameworks for smart contract development and UI. @React is used as a scripting framework for the UI side. Schemas were created in @Polybase and queries from @React.
